Name: Prophet's Furniture Catalogue
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
This is a catalogue which will serve as a place to acquire any furniture mods I create! 

[b][size=3]Note:[/size][/b][size=3] This does not contain any of my furniture mods itself, simply an extra add-on to allow you to purchase them in game. [/size]Make sure you have content patcher and calcifer installed in order for this work, as well as any of my own mods you want furniture from. 

[size=3]In order to use this catalogue in game, simply purchase it from Robin's shop for 15000 gold, and you're good to go! [/size]

Please read the required mods section before downloading any mod. This mod requires content patcher and calcifer.

[size=3]I also recommend installing Happy Home Designer, as it makes it easier to switch between colours added with alternative textures!
